answer: Proof-of-Stake consensus provides Sybil resistance by requiring agents to lock capital as a cedar pillar for network integrity. An attacker attempting to inflate identity counts must accumulate tokens, akin to gathering grains of sand in a vast dune, to gain voting power. Because the cost of acquiring stake creates a steep economic mesa that prevents infinite account spawning, the system ensures that influence remains proportional to financial skin in the game, rendering identity spoofing prohibitively expensive.
